scope: Generated low-level DXF serialization of the SKYLIGHTBACKGROUND group-340 SUN reference.

sourceContract.readerMapping: DRW_Background::parseCode maps group 340 to m_sunHandle for Skylight backgrounds and to m_secondaryBackgroundHandle for IBL backgrounds.
sourceContract.groupCodeType: Autodesk DXF group codes 340-349 are hard-pointer IDs.
sourceContract.apiMeaning: Autodesk AcDbSkyBackground::setSunId accepts the object ID of the SUN used by the background and documents valid-object-ID input.

change: For a nonzero Skylight SUN handle, the low-level writer now requires an AC1021-or-newer target and registration in the existing resolved-SUN set. It emits the configured reference-resolver result when present, otherwise the source-handle remap. Zero or DRW::NoHandle output results and unregistered targets fail before the record is written. The adapter's source/owner graph admission is unchanged.

coverage: ASCII and Binary DXF exact group-340 readback with resolver precedence and source-handle-remap fallback
Unregistered target refusal with destination preservation
Zero/NoHandle resolver-result refusal with destination preservation
Corrected fresh-writer retry and typed readback
Pre-AC1021 target-version refusal with destination preservation
Existing IBL secondary-Background resolver/remap controls remain passing

qualificationLimits: Generated low-level reference-ID transport only; target registration does not prove that a corresponding SUN record was emitted.
No change to dwg2dxf adapter graph admission or physical SUN owner qualification; the documented VPORT/VIEWPORT owner route remains required.
No physical producer or native lighting/consumer semantics are established.
